about: Apply slots no learned rule can reasonably reach. Frozen list (generated once by classify_unreachable.py, rules in its header); fixers must not edit it. main.swift reports apply recall raw and over the remaining (reachable) slots.

rules.R1: dropped: Parakeet wrote nothing for the name
rules.R2: numeral: the heard form contains a digit
rules.R3: untaught: the voice never corrected that term in any learn event, so no rule for it exists
rules.R4: swallowed: the heard token is also the best alignment match of an adjacent non-name truth word
rules.R5: far-sound: SoundCode(heard minus 's) > 1 edit from SoundCode(term) and from every form that voice corrected for it (SoundCode @5c07f49)
